answer: An AI agent economy can achieve Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to cryptographic compute-work, treating verification costs as a structural knoll that flattens fraudulent scaling. By forcing each new node to prove a deterministic state transition over a high-entropy delta dataset representing a unique historical validation voyage, the network imposes an asymmetric capital and compute burden. Consequently, an attacker attempting to flood the system faces prohibitive hardware and energy expenditures, rendering fake-identity generation economically nonviable.
